title: Machine learning guides proofs of braid and flat-braid invariants
summary: A one-hidden-layer multilayer perceptron classified examples of three-strand braids and suggested algebraic criteria. Authors converted the observed patterns into proofs. The paper proves a complete criterion for triviality of flat braids on three strands; its result does not establish a complete invariant for arbitrary braids or the neural network itself as a proof system.
organization: University of Liverpool; University of Essex
